answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 48489 Country: Bangladesh Title: Question regarding Salam Question: Is it permitted in Islam to take and give salam during eating food? Would you kindly inform me? Answer ID: 48489 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1492/1152/B=11/1434) We should not greet one who is busy eating. It is not wajib on the person who is eating to answer the salam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
